title: Neon Museum

services.name: Past Exhibitions
services.desc: The Neon Museum’s exhibitions offer a dynamic, historic lens on the evolution of Las Vegas-revealing how the city’s stories are shaped by the people, performances, and cultural milestones that define it. These exhibitions have explored the personal legacies behind the neon glow, shedding light on how individual narratives contribute to the broader history of Las Vegas. The Person, The Persona: Debbie Reynolds in Las Vegas honored the iconic entertainer whose career was deeply intertwined with the city’s showbiz past. Through rare photographs and personal artifacts, the exhibition celebrated Reynolds’ place in the entertainment history of Las Vegas. Stories from Backstage: Cirque du Soleil
